brief_title: Checklist voiceover that names the day four quit
hook_spoken: I quit every checklist by day four until this one.
hook_on_screen_text: The checklist that made me consistent

structure.beat: Voiceover names the day four quit over b roll of a crossed out list
Shows the shorter checklist that replaced it
Ends on a saved streak and a save this line

topic_shown: A paper checklist, with a habit app visible in one shot
why_it_worked: the first line names the exact moment people give up, so the viewer feels caught, and the b roll is cheap enough to reshoot every week
adaptation: say the day four line in the creator's own voice and show their own shorter list replacing the long one
avoid: The vague consistency is a muscle voiceover with no moment and no number in it
